RaceName: JenningsBet Over 200 Shops Nationwide Handicap
Spotlight: Generally disappointing since opening account at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) in February but kept on for third off reduced mark on recent stable debut at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) and drops in grade here; respected.

RaceName: JenningsBet Over 200 Shops Nationwide Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent maiden who has made the frame from off the pace on all three starts for her new stable this summer (5f-6f, good to firm); remains on the same mark; probably on the premises again.

RaceName: JenningsBet Over 200 Shops Nationwide Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark with clearcut C&D (good) success in June and didn't really enjoy the run of the race when fourth behind heavily backed stablemate at Windsor (6f, good to firm) a fortnight later; sure to be suited by return to this track and may still have a bigger run in her.

RaceName: JenningsBet Over 200 Shops Nationwide Handicap
Spotlight: Gave good account when fourth over 7f on Tapeta a fortnight ago and is now 1lb lower than for 5f Polytrack win in March; 6f on fast turf should also suit; no surprise if he features.

RaceName: JenningsBet Over 200 Shops Nationwide Handicap
Spotlight: Won three times (once over C&D) for another stable as a 2yo; yet to hit top gear for current trainer (eight runs since April) but recent efforts have been respectable and he continues to edge down the weights.

RaceName: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears
Spotlight: Multiple hurdle winner over 2m-2m1f who is 1-6 on turf in this code (1m4f win on soft); below her best in both codes across her last two starts but if able to reproduce her Ripon effort from mid-June (1m4f, good) then she could come into this over a shorter trip but a much stiffer track.

RaceName: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Appears to prefer Beverley to elsewhere, having secured four of his five wins there, at up to 8.5f; has been a close second and third over 1m2f there on his last two starts; big player if as effective here.

RaceName: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: 22-race maiden (placed at up to 11.5f) whose better efforts over the past 12 months would give him each-way claims; needs to bounce back after a couple of below-par AW efforts.

RaceName: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Held up when winning this last year (good to firm) off 4lb higher mark; returns in good form after being placed twice at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) on his last two starts; major contender.

RaceName: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: 1m course winner (stays 1m3f) who won back-to-back starts at Beverley (both 8.5f, sound surface) in May/June; below par here (1m, good) on her penultimate start but posted a better effort at Redcar (1m1f, good to firm) latest; needs another step back in the right direction.

RaceName: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: A Quirke & Mrs G B Walford
Spotlight: 1-14 (win was over 1m2f, good to firm); yet to reproduce last year's better efforts in 2026 and finished last of nine on AW (1m4f) latest; more needed.

RaceName: Honda Wakefield Super-N Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: 1m2f turf winner (good) who has won over 1m3f on AW; holds place claims if back to the form of his third at Chepstow (on stable debut) in June.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Six-time AW winner for Alice Haynes; well below best form for new stable this year but his two recent turf runs in this grade (1m/7f, good to firm) were fairly respectable, and he might be boosted by the refitted blinkers here.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Won in this grade at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in March and is also suited by this track but her recent handicap form has been disappointing; tried in a visor on latest outing; cheekpieces are refitted today.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Dual AW winner (8.4f/1m) in this grade at start of this year; ran as though something was amiss when back on turf last month but has possibilities if back on song.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Narrow winner of C&D (good to firm) handicap in September and went close in this grade here (7f, good) in June; safely held on AW at Lingfield since but was poorly positioned on outside of the field there and can do better here.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Gained five of his 11 wins at this track; not at best in three handicaps since returned to turf in June but was only beaten about 2l when fifth of seven at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last time and is strong interest in this lower grade and with cheekpieces refitted.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 20-race maiden who returned from a break with two disappointing runs this summer (1m/7f), the latter in this grade in refitted cheekpieces; not yet proven over 1m; others have much stronger claims.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Yet fully to convince stamina-wise over 1m but came second in this grade at Lingfield (7.6f/7f, good to firm) on her last two outings and features prominently in calculations.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 0-9 when trained by Jack Channon; placed in Pontefract handicap (1m2f, good to soft) in September but absent since heavy defeat on AW in October; usual tongue-tie left off for this seasonal/stable debut.

RaceName: JenningsBet In Deal Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts; ran quite well when sixth of 13 in Bath handicap (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June but was soundly beaten in 7f classified here (good to firm) later that month; needs to find extra.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: By Advertise; second foal; dam unplaced 7f/1m (RPR 43), half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Mild Illusion, out of unraced half-sister to useful 6f/7f winner Courageous; this Newmarket challenger makes his debut in a race lacking depth and could play a major role; watch the betting.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Soundly beaten at 40-1 on last month's debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm); however, this 55,000gns yearling has potential in his pedigree and this is an easier race than last time; not ruled out.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: A market check is advised on this second start but he was always behind after a slow start at Catterick (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago, when sent off at 33-1 wearing blinkers (same today); transformation needed.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 30,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; weakened quickly when tailed off at 33-1 on recent debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm); may be one for later on.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 78,000gns yearling, £65,000 2yo breeze-ups; second foal; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Find (Group-placed 6f/7f) and Third Kingdom (useful 7f/1m), out of US 8.5f 2yo Grade 1 winner; trainer is enjoying a good year with his 2yos and this Starman newcomer could be a contender.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Not at his best at Redcar (5f, good) in June last time when making it 0-3; however, gelded since and he went close at Carlisle (5f, good to soft) two starts ago, having previously shown promise at York (6f, good); top trainer has won the last two runnings; leading claims on penultimate form.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; dam French 1m1f-1m4f winner, sister to winners Thunder Eclipse (useful 6f 2yo) and Eclipse Emerald (6f), family of outstanding Dubai Millennium; check the betting, but this Space Blues newcomer is likely to improve for the run.

RaceName: Jayne - On Course Lady Bookmaker EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten just over 5l when seventh of 11 on last month's debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) but she was nibbled into 12-1 and there was some promise in that performance; this 90,000euros breeze-up buy has a useful pedigree and could be sharper for her debut experience; interesting contender.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Showed career-best form when leading close home at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last month and has now won under Oliver Carmichael on two of his last three outings; ought to cope with the undulations here and can make his presence felt again.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Dual 7f winner this season; looked as good as ever when clear second to progressive rival at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago but recent 4lb rise demands a bit more from him here.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) in September and was also on target at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in April; recent efforts have been respectable and he holds each-way claims at least.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Ex-French filly who was safely held on both British starts this spring (7f/1m) and needs subsequent wind surgery to have made a big difference.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Belatedly came good with clearcut Ascot win (7f, good to firm) last month, his 12th start, and was not discredited when ninth in big-field sprint at Glorious Goodwood a week ago; will be suited by this return to 1m and may still have a bit more to offer.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Won 7f AW novice in January; returned from break with three poor handicap runs in the spring but, having been gelded, his keeping-on fifth at Epsom (7f, good) last month was much more encouraging; still unexposed over 1m; interesting.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: Managed only ninth of 11 on last month's handicap debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) but was placed in two of his three qualifying races (7f/7.4f) and could still have significant potential.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
OwnerName: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner
Spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who came from off the pace to score over C&D (good) in June; below form at Epsom since, though, and probably doesn't have much margin for error off current mark.

RaceName: Sapporo Japanese Premium Lager Brighton Mile Challenge Handicap (The Brighton Mile Challenge Trophy)
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner who has made the frame four times on turf this summer (6f-7.6f); disappointed on latest outing, having been restless in the stalls, but his current mark is workable and he'll be fine over today's trip.

RaceName: Riu Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap
Spotlight: Multiple winner at up to 8.5f on good or slower; on the slide in three starts this season but this combination of a drop in grade and new headgear may prompt a resurgence; return to shorter is also a plus; shortlisted.

RaceName: Riu Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap
Spotlight: Her wins have come on slow ground but she appears to act on good to firm; latest success came on AW (1m) in April, when 2lb lower; below that level in three turf starts since.

RaceName: Riu Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap
Spotlight: Prolific winning veteran, mostly over 1m on a sound surface; most recent success came in this race last year, when 8lb higher; supported when a close second at Ripon latest start; respected.

RaceName: Riu Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap
Spotlight: 1m winner (good and good to soft); on a handy mark if able to return to last season's form but has been well below that level this time; tongue-tie now accompanies usual cheekpieces; trainer also runs Spirit Genie.

RaceName: Riu Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap
Spotlight: Multiple winner over 1m-1m2f; versatile regarding going; 12lb lower than his most recent win at Ripon 13 months ago; plenty to prove based on five of his six starts this season.

RaceName: Riu Hotels And Resorts Ladies Day Veterans' Handicap
Spotlight: Has had more AW than turf success; has gained both wins in this sphere at Nottingham (8.5f on good/good to soft); only midfield when returned to grass last time; others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Long in the tooth now and not firing on all cylinders this season but, from a reduced mark, ran well in defeat over C&D (good to firm) in June; had excuse (lame) when below form here last month; big player if all goes to plan this time.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but just did enough to cause 22-1 surprise on recent seasonal debut at Salisbury (1m, good to firm; front pair clear), and could be seen to even better effect now back up in trip.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed after only five runs (one in a bumper) but was unable to land a significant blow when well-held third of four over C&D (good to firm) on handicap debut in June; improvement required.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Took form to new level when scoring at Leicester (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago, her second success this season; 6lb higher here but could have untapped potential over this new trip; must be considered.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Slightly disappointing on both starts since emphatic success at Hamilton (1m1f, good to soft) in June and still needs to prove he's effective on fast ground but his current mark is workable and he can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Monty Bennetts 18th Birthday Handicap
Spotlight: Benefited from combination of step up in trip and first-time cheekpieces when making all over C&D (good to firm) in June, her seventh start; open to further progress but needs to bounce back from a disappointing effort at Leicester last month.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
OwnerName: J A Swinburne & Mrs Ruth A Carr
Spotlight: Won this last year and kicked off this campaign with two wins in a row, the second of them over C&D; he's run well in defeat over C&D on his last two starts and there's every chance he'll again be bang there.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: He's on a career-low mark but has finished down the field on his three starts since making an encouraging return to action at Ripon in May; needs to turn things around.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: Posted two good thirds at the start of last month (5f/5.6f, good to firm) before midfield finish in big-field Class 4 at York (6f, good to firm); the drop back in trip/grade can help and he could be in the mix.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: 0-17 on turf as opposed to 7-26 on AW and unplaced on grass on his two starts this summer; however, he gave it a good go from the front at Chester (5f, good) last time when he used up lots of energy early from his wide draw, and he could be a serious force from the inside berth today.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: Got up late to win at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month; denied clear run when close fifth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) next time and kept on for third at Thirsk (6f, good) last Saturday; it's possible he'll get going too late back down to 5f but the stiff track and strong pace will help; chance.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: Made all at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) in June and bounced back from lesser run at Windsor to make all under Elle-May Croot at Ayr (5f, good to firm) last time; the widest draw may not be ideal but this in-form 3yo is still respected.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: Up and down during this 3yo campaign but he was a good third at Musselburgh (5f, good) in April and would have been closer than sixth at Chester (5f, good) recently granted a clear run; could be involved.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: Having dropped back down to his last winning mark he won well at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in June, but had just two rivals to beat; only sixth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) since and he's never won off a mark this high.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: Absent since below-par run at Newcastle last November (wind op in interim); however, she won three times in the second half of last year, two of them here, and she ran well first time up last term; not discounted.

RaceName: FBS Chartered Accountants Chaplins Club Handicap
Spotlight: Speedy 3yo who made all at Catterick (6f, good) in May; raced alone against the far rail when sixth of 12 at Newcastle (5f, AW) in June and shaped when fourth at Leicester (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago as though the return to 5f would be well worth a go; could make a bold bid.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Eight-time winner; lurks on a dangerous mark and might be perked up by first-time cheekpieces but has looked out of sorts on all three starts since returning from a layoff in April; leap of faith required to support her.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Returned to turf with two decent efforts (both 7f, good) this spring, and his keeping-on fifth at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month was perfectly respectable; would appeal more on ground slower than good but still considered each-way.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Three-time course winner who has finished second four consecutive (twice over C&D on good to firm) since swapping cheekpieces for blinkers in May; likely to be right in the thick of things again.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Placed twice on Polytrack this year (1m/7f); safely held on both starts since returned to turf but this is easier than the Sandown race she contested last month, and she's now 2lb lower than for last summer's C&D win; worth a second look.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Raced far too freely in the lead before dropping out tamely on recent handicap debut at Sandown (7f, good to firm); remains unexposed after only four starts and is open to significant improvement if/when he learns to settle but comes with obvious risk attached.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Came good at Southwell (1m, AW) in October, his second handicap, but has gone the wrong way since; in rear throughout at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last month, after a break, and needs to have taken significant benefit from that outing.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; seemed to respond well to first-time visor when third of six at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last month and should be fine over this extra furlong; now tries cheekpieces; enters calculations.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Close third in classified race here (5.2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June but was just a respectable fourth at Wolverhampton (5f, AW; first-time blinkers) last month and is now 0-26; needs to find something extra on this first venture beyond 6f.

RaceName: JenningsBet "We Love Brighton Racecourse" 'Confined' Handicap (Horses With No Wins In 2026)
Spotlight: Well beaten at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and has now been unplaced all 14 starts; usual tongue-tie left off here; difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: Goes well here and arrives seeking a hat-trick after wins at Catterick and over C&D (readily latest; both good to firm); carries penalty but on last week's evidence that may still not stop him.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: Has won back-to-back starts at Chester (7f, good) and here over C&D (good to firm) under a penalty latest; up 7lb and in grade so this will be tougher but he enters calculations.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: Prolific winner, mainly over 6f, the latest when 2lb higher at Catterick (6f, good) in April; went close when on this mark in successive starts last month, before a below-par effort in a big-field York sprint latest; player if he can bounce back.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: Took eight starts to break his duck but he's now strung three improving efforts together, scoring at Catterick (7f, good to soft) and by over 3l at Epsom (7f, good to firm) latest; up 7lb; his prominent style of racing and the stiff track may enable him to cope with the drop to 6f; unexposed and interesting.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: Multiple 6f winner; inconsistent but back in better form when under 2l fourth at Goodwood (6f, good to firm) last week; same mark; enters calculations.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: Multiple winner over 5f-7f, including here; versatile regarding ground; 1lb higher than latest win at Thirsk in May; matched that effort on his penultimate start but may find a couple too good on these terms.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner; all wins on good or slower but acts on fast ground; 1l second from this mark at Thirsk last month but needs to shrug off two lesser efforts.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
OwnerName: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing
Spotlight: 5f and 6f winner, most recently in a 0-70 at Doncaster (good to firm) on his penultimate start; found out from this mark and in this grade in a big field at York latest; more needed.

RaceName: Bet With Jayne - Your Local Bookmaker Handicap
Spotlight: 5f and 6f winner; returned from a break to finish 9l fourth behind Alfa Whiteburd over C&D recently; entitled to have needed that outing and drops 2lb but could have his work cut out in this line-up.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Three-time C&D winner, most recently last May; absent since two disappointing runs here last August, though, and would appeal more on good or slower ground.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Three wins this year, the latest by a nose over C&D (good to firm) in May; still in good form, albeit he was behind Faustus when third over C&D (good to firm; winner did it easily) last month; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Returned to form with narrow win at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) in June; remains on workable mark after 3lb rise and is very well suited by this track (four-time C&D winner) but managed only fifth of six at Bath (5f, firm) three weeks ago and has become unreliable.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Placed three times from seven starts since returned to turf in May; no match for easy winner when second over C&D (good to firm) last month and remains well below the best of last year's form but still has possibilities; often wears cheekpieces but goes in refitted blinkers today.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts; outran 50-1 odds when respectable fifth of 14 in Bath handicap (5f, good) in June and was denied clear run when filling same position in Chepstow classified (5f, good to firm) last month but others appeal more all the same.

RaceName: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Placed twice here this year (5.2f/6f) but ran poorly at Bath last month and it's now exactly two years since her last win; difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Very lightly raced 5yo who has been unable to fulfil the significant promise shown when winning in 2023 on his second outing; however, he didn't run badly in fourth of five here (2m2f, good) in June on his second stable start and this is less competitive; could be a contender.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made all at Ripon (1m4f, good) in May on stable debut and he's been a good second on two of his three starts since (1m4f, good/good to firm), including here; didn't convince with his stamina for 2m back in January 2025 but a staying trip is worth another go and he's a major player if seeing it out.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) in June when back from a break; unplaced at odds-on over hurdles next time and also below par when back on the Flat at York (2m, good to firm) most recently; however, the first-time cheekpieces could give him a lift and there can be optimism that this trip will be within range; trainer won this last year; in calculations.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Raced only on turf; has failed to back up the form of her spring win at Ripon; chance depends on the effects of new surface and another change of headgear.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Showed promise on debut; has failed to beat a rival at Royal Ascot and Yarmouth for new yard since but this switch to nursery level may prompt a turnaround.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown ability with fourth-place finishes at Windsor and Goodwood; may be capable of progress in nurseries and yard keeps it in the family with Toby Moore taking off 7lb; one to bear in mind.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown steady progress on turf; won at Ffos Las (5f; nursery debut) most recently, leaving the impression this return to 6f will suit; half-sister to a smart performer who is 2-2 on AW; respected.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has shown ability over 5f while twice leaving the impression he'll be well suited by today's extra furlong; made late gains, without landing a blow, in the Super Sprint last time; one to consider.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Similar type to Nascent Star, having shown some promise over 5f while looking as if she'll benefit from this step up to 6f; not disgraced when favourite on nursery debut last time; still of interest.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has made the frame under 7lb claimer in sprint maidens at Windsor and Nottingham, doing enough to think he can make his mark in ordinary nurseries; Colin Keane is booked for this first attempt; interesting.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: E Kelly, J Woods, N Gallagher & Partner
Spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who looks the type to benefit from stepping out of novice level but doesn't appear to have a generous opening mark; not well treated on bare figures.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who has inconsistent form and seems to be more exposed than most of today's rivals; failed to improve for visor last time; headgear retained.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who posted clear best effort when sixth at Newbury; not the most convincing contender on form but she's in good hands and may improve now handicapping.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Faced stiff task on penultimate start; has some AW winners in her pedigree and ran well (2l second) in 6f novice event at Southwell switched to this sphere last time; may build on that effort; possibilities.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Favourite for her debut in a 17-runner maiden at the Curragh last September, broke slowly, recovered to challenge before fading late; disappointed at Leopardstown in October when heavy ground may have been against her; has a bit to find with Taj Crown on running at Killarney, but less exposed than that rival.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Ran twice for Dermot Weld late last season; showed winning potential when third behind two of the principal fancies in a 1m4f maiden at Galway last week; 100-1 then, entitled to be one of the market leaders now.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Second to useful yardstick Merlin The Giant in 1m4f optional claimer at Limerick in June; has obtained two more seconds since then, behind a much superior type in a maiden at Killarney and behind longer-priced stablemate at Ballinrobe; should not be far away.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Six wins in Britain; gained a first Irish success at Naas last October, scoring at 25-1 in a 16-runner handicap; previous form included a second placing in a Ballinrobe claimer, and sixth of 12 in the corresponding race to this; seasonal debut.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Two wins for Richard Hannon, both over 1m2f on easy ground; modest form so far over hurdles and on the Flat for this yard; soundly beaten in Ballinrobe claimer on latest; however, she met trouble in running and is probably capable of better.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
OwnerName: Mrs N K Griffin & T Brosnan
Spotlight: In good form lately in races in this category; won with plenty to spare over 1m4f at Tramore and then second to a well-fancied rival over 1m at Killarney; this trip should be fine.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens at around this trip; stayed on for third over 1m at Cork in June on his handicap debut; could be in the mix now.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Won over 1m in France last season; began this season with a handicap mark of 90 and was not out of his depth when eighth in the 25-runner Irish Lincoln; has slumped in the ratings after a series of poor displays; some signs of a revival at Galway last week; not ruled out now that he is dropped in grade.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Weak form in maidens last season; 10l sixth of nine in a Fairyhouse race in this grade on final start; 10b claimer up for stable/ seasonal debut.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Stable in superb form; however, this one has shown next to nothing in maidens; may improve.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Won a handicap over a longer trip at this venue last year; has a respectable record at Dundalk, placed seven times from 15 visits; below best there last month.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Ordinary form on the Flat and over hurdles; never in the first three; not one of the more appealing candidates.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Off the mark at the 15th attempt in a 1m4f Roscommon handicap last month (yielding-to-soft), coming from off the pace; down the field in two staying handicaps in June; this trip may prove inadequate.

RaceName: Carlsberg Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Weak overall form, and down the field in a handicap last time; however, she has reached the money in both outings in this grade, third at Ballinronbe in May and second at Fairyhouse last month.

RaceName: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up here over 1m two starts back, then went one better here eight days ago, also over 1m; now drops back to 6f for the first time since his second start and that would be a concern under a 5lb penalty.

RaceName: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: All three wins have been on the AW (7f/1m) but he ran up to his best when third of ten at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; good claims if coping with the drop back to 6f.

RaceName: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins on turf have been on ground slower than good and his last four wins have been on the AW; beat only one rival home at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago and now drops back in trip with promising amateur Henry Callan taking over in the saddle; visor back on.

RaceName: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: 2-41 on turf, the latest success coming at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last May; runner-up on his last two starts, latest over 5f at that venue 12 days ago, and warrants respect now stepped back up in trip.

RaceName: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Five-time winner on turf over 6f, most recently at Chepstow last June off 2lb higher; failed to beat a rival on his reappearance and he was behind Shades Of May when seventh at Salisbury (7f) two weeks ago; others preferred.

RaceName: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win from 23 starts came at Newcastle in September 2024; runner-up at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) and Catterick (7f, good to firm) in July, but ran poorly at Ripon last time; may be able to bounce back.

RaceName: Gold & Silver Exchange Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: 17-race maiden who has shown little in three starts since joining this stable; first-time tongue-tie and blinkers combination needs to make a big difference.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by St Mark's Basilica; 110,000euros yearling; half-brother to 1m1f 2yo/1m2f winner South Island (RPR 101); dam 1m2f-1m3f winner (including French Listed; 100), half-sister to winners Acadius (7.5f Listed), Aconito (7f/1m4f), Andraxt (9.5f) and A Kind Of Magic (1m3f); stable has a fine record with 2yo newcomers and plenty to like on pedigree; entered in the Goffs Million.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Dark Angel; 450,000gns yearling; brother to winners Charyn (6f/1m including 2yo/Group 1; RPR 127) and Wings Of War (6f including 2yo Group 2; 110); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (including AW; 99), out of 5f 2yo winning sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Galeota; in-form stable gets plenty of 2yo winners first time out and his pedigree makes a market check crucial.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: February foal by U S Navy Flag; 25,000gns yearling; half-brother to five winners including Interlocuter (1m-10.5f including AW/France/Australia; RPR 104), Spellwork (1m; 104) and Aslan (UAE 1m1f-1m3f; 93); dam UAE 1,000 Guineas/UAE Oaks winner (109), sister to Middle Park winner Lujain; plenty to like on breeding, but stable has few 2yos go in first time.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Well beaten in three starts over 6f/7f on turf/AW; gelded since last seen and it will need to have made a dramatic difference; low-grade handicaps may be more his thing; stable also runs Off The Peg.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 42,000gns foal, 58,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Another Investment (6f/7f including 2yo; RPR 95), Shrara (6f 2yo; 71) and Ibn Alwaleed (KSA 1m 2yo); dam US 5f 2yo/6f dirt winner, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Council Member; stable gets its share of 2yo winners first time and worth monitoring in the market.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: February foal by Sioux Nation; 45,000gns foal, 55,000gns yearling; half-brother to six winners including Orchid (6f AW including 2yo; RPR 88), True Wisdom (1m 2yo; 85), Light Beam (UAE 1m1f; 81) and Clear White Light (1m4f Flat, 72; 2m-2m4f hurdle); dam 7f/1m winner (including Listed; 100); stable has the occasional 2yo winner first time, but probably only of interest if backed.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
OwnerName: B Dickson, P Cook & R Rexton
Spotlight: 150,000gns yearling; didn't enjoy the clearest of runs when sixth of ten on his Newbury debut (6f, good to firm) last month (fifth has won since); shortlisted with the experience on his side.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 52,000gns foal, 58,000gns yearling, 95,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to 5f 2yo winner Vishaka (RPR 71); dam 8.6f AW winner (56), half-sister to winners Dancing King (1m6f Group 3) and Starstruck (US 1m1f Grade 3), out of smart 5f/6f winner; tongue tied on debut and others appeal a bit more on breeding, but his stable's fine record with 2yo newcomers makes him worth a market check.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Connacht Oaks Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Won two small-field events last summer, a 1m2f claimer at Fairyhouse and a 1m1f handicap at Leopardstown; surpassed that form when a close fourth in the Listed 1m4f Galtres Stakes at York; never in a challenging position in a Listed race at Dundalk in September; absent since and may need this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Connacht Oaks Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Gained third career win at Down Royal in June, bolting up over a similar trip to this; hit with a 14lb rise for that; struggled over 1m4f in a premier handicap at Galway last week, bringing a consistent sequence to an end; this trip is closer to her optimum.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Connacht Oaks Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Useful on the Flat in France, winning twice and Listed-placed; bought for E250,000 at the Arqana sales in late 2024; off for over a year before a run on the Flat at Dundalk last November; useful form in two maiden hurdle starts, 12l second to Bambino Fever on the second occasion; career-best was over 1m7f in a Listed race, this might be too sharp.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Connacht Oaks Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner at around 1m with ease in the ground on all occasions; handles good ground too and is also effective beyond a mile, as she showed when second in a fillies' handicap over an extended 1m3f at Killarney; has made the frame in all except one of her last seven starts.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Connacht Oaks Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Won narrowly at Roscommon in June and went very close to repeating last year's success in a 1m4f Galway handicap; due to go up 3lb for finishing a neck second; holds an obvious chance, providing this does not come too soon; last year's second in this event came after the same four-day interval.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has performed to an ordinary level in her first two races over shorter; one for another day.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Kept on for third on debut at Salisbury (5f, good to firm) in May and didn't enjoy run of the race when below that form at Goodwood 19 days later; those races were won by useful types and this filly is bred to be suited by this move up in trip.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 66-1 and trailed home last over 7f at Newmarket in June; opposable.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1,000gns foal; prominent to a point at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) before trailing home last.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well related; 11-2 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) where she faded out of it to be about 5l off the winner; needs more and a hood is soon turned to.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Showed plenty more second time out at Newbury when just ahead of Lady Of Hay; unlikely that a repeat of that will be good enough to trouble the best of these.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £140,000 breeze-up 2yo and she was only a short-head behind Jaan Ki Tukri, who ran quite well to be ninth in the Coventry, when third at Bath (5f, good to firm); that debut run was in May so she's been out for a while, but interesting otherwise.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Cost 75,000gns as a yearling and a half-sister to three winners, while dam was smart at 6f/7f; has to be of interest kicking off at this level, all the more so if at all strong in the market.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stable has won the last two runnings of this maiden; 300,000gns yearling; easy to back at 11-1 for a maiden at the July meeting, she didn't have the clearest of runs in finishing behind Speed Of Sound; should show more.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Favourite for debut at Newmarket's July meeting and went down narrowly; the fourth reversed those placings at Ascot (again over 6f on good to firm) but this filly still ran very well in defeat; should be difficult to beat here.

RaceName: A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: Serio Racing Stables, USA Steeplechase Et Al

RaceName: A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
A P Smithwick Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Grade 1) (Turf)
Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Friendless in the betting but showed some promise, amid greenness, in 7f event at Newbury where he kept on for seventh of 12; the form received a boost at Glorious Goodwood last week; the pick of the runners with experience.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 16,000euros foal, £62,000 yearling; Persian Force half-brother to 7.5f 2yo winner Leblon Queen (RPR 62), out of unraced half-sister to Swedish 1m3f scorer Sel Sea; Amo/Hannon newcomer who is one to bear in mind.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 90,000euros foal; by Invincible Spirit and first foal of 6f/7f winner (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 109); major stable; possibilities.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 48,000gns foal, 105,000gns yearling; by Intello and first foal of French 7f turf/7.5f AW scorer (RPR 86) who is half-sister to three Group winners and daughter of 5f 2yo Group 3 winner; likely type, based on sales information and pedigree.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 24,000euros then £10,000 yearling, 20,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Sioux Nation half-brother to Italian 5f 2yo winner Many Kisses, out of 1m winner (including 2yo; RPR 75); others are more interesting.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 70,000gns yearling; Saxon Warrior half-brother to two winners, notably Albula (Group-placed 1m 2yo; RPR 98); dam Australian 7.7f/1m scorer (including Group 3; 103); represents in-form major yard; respected newcomer.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Always behind and finished last of ten, beaten about 11l, in 6f contest at Newbury having been easy to back; however, may fare better upped to 7f with that experience under his belt.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Sole filly in this field; similar type to Sayid Harry Angel having been beaten about 11l in Newbury event (6.5f) on debut, finishing sixth of seven; may improve with that outing under her belt.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Massive price when finishing with only one behind in an 18-runner maiden at Naas a fortnight ago.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Faded to finish last of ten first time out at Gowran; unlikely to feature.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Mid-division in maidens at Fairyhouse and Roscommon; may get closer to the action now with the champion jockey aboard; trainer also runs Roeillaun with another leading rider aboard.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E15,000 yearling; first foal; by Bayside Boy; dam 1m winner for Dermot Weld, half-sister to two winners; worth a market check.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Cotai Glory colt out of an unraced half-sister to Trawlerman; lots of stamina in the pedigree; showed up well enough when seventh over 6f at Navan on debut; faces rematch with Lucy's Promise (sixth) and Candle Glow (tenth); could be a factor now with normal improvement.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Failed to go forward from a respectable 7f Leopardstown debut when finishing in rear over 1m at Bellewstown.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Not far behind Lucy's Promise (sixth) and The Green Helmet (seventh) when tenth of 17 at Navan; open to improvement.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Plenty of improvement needed from her opening efforts at Naas and Cork; her trainer appears to have a better chance with Elyatta.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Miss Kate Harrington & Mrs John Harrington & B Phelan
Spotlight: Creditable runs since debut second over 5f at Naas; fourth to subsequent Group 2 winner Sun Goddess over 6f at the Curragh, and latest Naas fourth over 5f has worked out well.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Lost ground at the start and was tailed off at Leopardstown; can be ruled out.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Did not show much on first two starts; took a step in the right direction when a staying-on sixth of 17 at Navan, in front of The Green Helmet (seventh) and Candle Glow (tenth); however, confidence is dented by her eclipse in a Curragh nursery, never looked like featuring, last of eight.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E2,000 yearling; first foal; Twilight Sun filly whose dam (by Iffraaj) won three races for the Johnstons; half-sister to winners Etes Vous Prets (Japanese 7f Grade 2) and Hawkesbury (UAE 1m Listed), out of 1m Group 1 winner.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Was beginning to get going late in a 5f maiden at Cork 12 days ago; longer distance should suit and she may be able to build on that initial outing.

RaceName: Strawberry Fields Stud Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Twice placed before flying too high at Royal Ascot; dropped back to 5f and sent off favourite, she quickened up well to win on nursery debut here four weeks ago; the 7lb rise was hefty enough but still considered.

RaceName: Strawberry Fields Stud Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: The 1-3 favourite when winning a 6f maiden at Ripon (good) before her no show in a Listed race; this mark looks high enough but she's hooded for the first time.

RaceName: Strawberry Fields Stud Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Beat Dowman on his debut and then ran third in the Lily Agnes; now threatening to go the wrong way as since gelded he's finished last in a nursery and beaten 6l in the Super Sprint.

RaceName: Strawberry Fields Stud Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Highly tried in two runs after a promising debut but only fifth of the six runners on her nursery debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) where she didn't get the clearest of runs but wasn't unlucky.

RaceName: Strawberry Fields Stud Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded during his two-month absence since justifying favouritism in a 5f novice at Windsor by a length when tried in a tongue-tie for the first time; that wasn't much of a race but he could well improve some more.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 12-1 but overcame a slow start and greenness when making a winning debut for Ralph Beckett in a 7f novice here last month; changed hands for 55,000gns soon afterwards; has a wide draw to overcome, but that initial effort was a taking one.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on his debut in a four-runner Sandown maiden (1m, good) a year ago, but improved when just getting up to win a novice over this C&D later that month (race has produced winners); may appreciate a bit further now, but still respected on his return and market should be informative.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Two starts for Joseph O'Brien earlier in year, appreciating the drop in trip when winning a Gowran Park maiden (1m, soft) in April; picked up for 34,000gns the following month and the market may indicate what is expected on stable debut.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 4-1 when making a winning debut at Salisbury (7f, good) last October (race has produced winners); high on list for in-form yard, especially if market positive.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in three bumpers and a maiden hurdle; returns from another long absence having undergone wind surgery; no appeal.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 68,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Vantheman (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 99) and Whisky McGonagall (5f including AW; 76); dam 6f winner (79), half-sister to 5f Listed winner/Nunthorpe runner-up Hamish McGonagall; already gelded and bred more for speed, while the stable doesn't have many winning newcomers.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 9-1 when third of 11 on his Windsor debut (1m, good to firm) last month (runner-up has won since); half-brother to a couple of AW winners and one for the shortlist.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Built on his debut here (7f) last October when second of nine at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) the following month, coming clear with a subsequent winner; returns from nine months off having been gelded and is respected despite widest draw; bang-in-form stable won this with a newcomer last year.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Brother to winners Logician (1m2f-14.5f including St Leger; RPR 121) and Collide (1m1f-1m6f including AW; 112), half-brother to six winners including Okeechobee (1m-1m2f including AW/Group 3; 117); dam 1m winner (103), half-sister to 1m1f Group 1 winner Cityscape; stable doesn't have many winners first time out, but he's still worth a market check given his classy pedigree.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 22,000gns yearling; dam twice-raced sister to 1m3f winner Utile, half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner Straight Answer, out of Group-placed 7f 2yo winning half-sister to 1m2f Group 1 winner Announce; already gelded and doesn't look a likely winner on debut.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 3,500euros yearling; half-brother to six winners including Triticum Vulgare (Italian 6f-1m1f including 2yo/Listed; RPR 87), Just Paul (7f/7.4f; 86) and Free One (7f AW; 78); dam placed 1m2f/1m4f (70); already gelded and would be a very rare winning newcomer from the yard.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 90,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Cajole (7f/1m including AW/Listed; RPR 104), Theoryofeverything (Group-placed 7f-1m1f; 102) and Persist (1m/1m2f; 100); dam 1m winner (including 2yo/AW/Group 1; 121), half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Creative Force; appealing pedigree but stable not known for winning newcomers.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fourth in two turf maidens (7f/1m) in June; nicely bred and should win races, but possibly in handicaps after this.

RaceName: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to 5f/6f winner Stone Circle, out of maiden half-sister to Listed-placed 7f-1m2f winner Valentina Guest; apprentice-ridden on debut and stable has few winners first time out.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Best of three maiden runs was on debut over 5f on soft ground at Cork; ran out a clear-cut winner of a five-runner 5f contest on handicap debut at Down Royal; up 6lb now and might be vulnerable in rematch with hampered third Mr Montauk.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in two maidens over 6f, though got into the money at Navan on the first occasion; not beaten far in fifth when taking on winners over 5f at Cork; faces much weaker opposition now and looks capable of making his presence felt.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Ran in decent company over 6f at Naas on his second start; drop to 5f at Bellewstown did not seem to suit him; may improve with cheekpieces.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Only mild promise in four maiden attempts; his opening handicap mark does not seem lenient.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Three-figure odds for all three starts in maidens and has run accordingly; her opening mark looks quite high.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Slight improvement from Naas debut to Navan next time; moderate run over 5f at Cork recently; others preferred.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Not beaten far when fourth of six on debut at Cork (5f, soft); no sign of progress on her next two starts; fifth of eight in a stronger nursery than this at the Curragh last month; that experience could be an asset now.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Three qualifying runs over 5f, all within the space of three weeks in April/May; sent off second-favourite for a 5f Down Royal nursery last month, got outpaced and then hampered at a crucial stage when staying on; could now reverse form with the winner Tatianna.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has finished in front of only a few rivals in her qualifying races; worth noting that her trainer won this with an unexposed type last year; cheekpieces may help.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Ran in a strong maiden at the Curragh on her second outing; in rear on all three starts; she will possibly find her level in handicaps; however, hard to be confident.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Weak form in two 5f outings; no better over 7f last time at Leopardstown; first-time blinkers will need to have a transformative impact.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Hard to make a case for her despite having contested maidens at three of the top tracks.

RaceName: John Gilligan Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has beaten only two of her 29 rivals in three races; has been given a low rating, but unlikely to feature on handicap debut.

RaceName: Origin Amenity Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Shaped with promise when fourth on his debut at Lingfield (1m2f, soft) in June and built on that when third of seven at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) next time; leading claims.

RaceName: Origin Amenity Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Booth, Silver, Steed And Fittocks Stud
Spotlight: Half-brother to 6f winner Waistcoat (RPR 80); always behind after slightly missing the break on his debut at Lingfield (1m, AW; hooded) last month and needs to take a big step forward now stepping up in trip.

RaceName: Origin Amenity Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 35,000gns yearling; colt by Admire Moon; first foal; dam runner-up 7f turf in Japan, half-sister to useful winners Memorial Day (1m-1m4f) and Mutafawwig (6f-1m), out of 1m2f Listed winning half-sister to French Derby winner Anabaa Blue; market should be informative on his debut.

RaceName: Origin Amenity Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Gelding by Time Test; first foal; dam 1m winner (including AW/Group 2; RPR 113), closely related to 1m5f/1m6f winner Mirrie Dancers, half-sister to Danish 1m1f Listed winner Moomba, out of 1m1f Group 3 winner; his dam won on her debut; interesting.

RaceName: Origin Amenity Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Down the field in two starts on the AW over 1m last November and has since been given wind surgery; tongue-tie is also added on her first start for 252 days and this half-sister to Group-placed 1m2f-1m5f winner Berkshire Breeze may be suited by this longer trip.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: From the family of his smart namesake; raced twice for Pat O'Rourke, belying 80-1 odds with emphatic success at Gowran Park (9.5f) last time; sold for 65,000gns since; sets the form standard upped further in trip.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Tailed-off last of seven in bumper; opposed.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Flat-bred 5yo who showed best form in bumpers when runner-up at Taunton on penultimate start; out of depth (well beaten) in Aintree Grade 2 latest; returns to a more suitable level on debut in this sphere.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Holds weak claims on bumper/Flat form, modest fourth at Windsor (11.5f) most recently; however, may improve for the switch to Kempton, being half-brother to a seven-time course winner for his connections.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Never-dangerous fifth, one place behind Digger One, in 11.5f event at Windsor having been slowly away; however, may do better with that experience under his belt.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Twice-raced gelding who has poor claims on form.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Well bred and represents major connections but hasn't lived up to expectations in two races (turf/AW); perhaps he'll find his feet and show progress in handicaps shortly.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
OwnerName: A D G Oldrey & G C Hartigan
Spotlight: Related to a few winners for his yard; duly showed promise in 1m2f event at Ffos Las where he was slowly away, looked green and raced in last place until making good late headway and nearly getting up; respected with progress on the cards.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Gelded son of Dubawi; siblings include two Group/Grade 1 winners for his connections, notably prolific Rebel's Romance (1m-1m6f; RPR 124) who recently retired; very interesting newcomer, especially if the market speaks positively.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Needs improvement on his 1m efforts (turf/AW) last autumn for Ger Lyons; sold for 12,000gns and gelded since; visor is added on reappearance; the betting may give further guidance.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Only a modest sixth of nine in 1m2f maiden at Windsor but is nicely bred and may be capable of improvement with that outing under his belt; one of two runners for Godolphin.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Absent and gelded since inauspicious effort (tailed-off last of 11) in 7f maiden at Sandown over a year ago; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Mildly promising debut over 1m at Naas in March, but heavy defeats since; out the back in Killarney claimer last time, and drops in trip now.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Pauline McCourt/Donal O'Leary/Don't Ask The Wife Synd
Spotlight: Yet to place, but two creditable efforts in big-field Curragh handicaps and has had a break since finishing tamely over 7f at Gowran; handles an ease and headgear goes on; drops in grade too.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Winner over 7f at Limerick last month, but pair of heavy defeats at Galway festival; wouldn't dismiss her chance back in less competitive contest here.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Had shown promise in 6f handicaps before winning over 6.5f at Limerick and was badly drawn at Gowran last time; some reasonable runs on soft ground early in the year, so if the rain comes, it may not scupper his chance.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
OwnerName: Syndicates Racing/W Jones/N O'Hare/Kabin Racing Syndicate
Spotlight: Decent runs in 6f all-aged handicaps on good/good to firm last twice, notably his Navan fourth to progressive type; first run in 3yo only handicap, but easy ground would be an unknown.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Had shown very little until front-running 200-1 fifth in 9.5f maiden at Ballinrobe; dropping back in trip might suit; second runner for yard.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: AW maiden winner and best turf run was when third of 17 over 6f at Fairyhouse in June; well beaten in race won by Glen Breeze at Limerick; better effort when just behind Dubai Opulence in all-aged contest at Cork.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Nursery winner over 6f for Michael Mulvany, but has shown little for current yard; bit better when fifth of seven over 5f at Down Royal.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
OwnerName: Scott Sterling & Darragh Cuffe & Conor Keohane
Spotlight: Glimmers of ability in maidens and first couple of handicaps; prominent before fading in final furlong when beaten 5l at Naas on Monday; visor replaces blinkers.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Last two handicap runs, against older rivals over 7f/6f, have been creditable and has a decent draw.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner but placed just once from nine starts on turf, that when third over 1m at Killarney; first-time cheekpieces were no help when faded tamely over 7f at Gowran.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Not clear run in first-time blinkers when around 6l off Glen Breeze at Limerick; yard has turned the corner, but the fact that she's entered in a claimer for 4k on Friday wouldn't inspire confidence.

RaceName: Baader - Eddie Carr PBR 2000 Handicap
Spotlight: Fair effort three starts back at Down Royal when beaten 6.5l by subsequent huge improver, but hasn't built on that; blinkers now tried.

RaceName: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
Spotlight: Only 1-16 on turf and 3-24 on the AW; well handicapped on his best form when previously with Mick Appleby and won over nearly 2m in France earlier this year; absent since April so market support would be welcomed.

RaceName: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
OwnerName: W Enticknap, B Ralph And Partner
Spotlight: A beaten favourite in his last two races, going down by 4l over C&D (soft) and then 6l over 1m4f on the AW; probably has a race in him off this mark given he's still lightly raced and cheekpieces go on.

RaceName: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
Spotlight: Belatedly off the mark in a classified race over the extended 1m3f here three weeks ago (good to firm); early days with this yard and could be competitive back in a handicap, despite going up 6lb.

RaceName: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten over 1m3f at Windsor last August and otherwise confined to the AW; a winner on Tapeta (1m6f; 2lb lower) and was running well back in the spring; hard to discount.

RaceName: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
OwnerName: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush
Spotlight: An infrequent winner but hasn't had a lot of racing since defying an 8lb higher mark over 2m at Ripon last August (good to firm); ran poorly when tried in blinkers once before (usually sports cheekpieces); Saffie Osborne rides but this filly has some questions to answer at present.

RaceName: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
OwnerName: M L W Bell Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Beaten just over 2l by Highland Harvery in a classified race here last month and has a 4lb pull on that rival; however, he broke slowly at Nottingham last time in another classified contest and never counted.

RaceName: Brandfords Restaurant & Bars Handicap
Spotlight: An 8yo who hasn't been at her best of late, on slow and fast ground; however, very capable off this sort of mark if staging a revival.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Improved from his belated debut in May when second of six at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) last month (fourth has won since); may again find one or two too good conceding weight to the 3yos.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Useful hurdler (RPR 140) for Nicky Henderson and Faye Bramley, but isn't really bred for this discipline; best watched on stable/Flat debut.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Improved from his May debut when winning making all and just holding on in a Windsor novice (1m2f, good to soft) the following month (runner-up 2-2 since); related to AW winners on the dam's side and respected despite penalty.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Steadily progressive in four starts, the latest when third of 11 at Windsor (1m, good to soft) in June (race has produced a couple of winners); wouldn't be sure to appreciate this longer trip on breeding, though.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
OwnerName: Mrs R F Greener And North Farm Stud
Spotlight: Improved from his June debut when third of six at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) last month, but has around 2l to find with Cloud Forest; handicaps may be more suitable.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Sent off 12-1 when fourth of 11 on his Newcastle debut (7f, Tapeta) in June; this longer trip should suit, but improvement will be needed.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 10,000euros foal; dam US 1m turf winner, sister to US 1m1f-1m3f Grade 3 winner Tricky Escape, out of US 1m Listed winner; only newcomer in the field and the market should provide clues.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Evens favourite when beaten 2l into third of 13 on her debut here (1m) in January (race has produced winners); this longer trip should suit on breeding and she's a big player if ready to go after seven months off.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
OwnerName: G Strawbridge, Ms R Hood & R Evans
Spotlight: 40-1 when well held on her Newmarket debut (7f, good to soft) in November; has an awkward draw, but is bred to be much better than that and the market should be revealing on her return.

RaceName: Becky Burke Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Comfortably held in both starts, the latest over C&D in June; looks one for handicaps.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
OwnerName: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit
Spotlight: Beat Canon Law by 2.5l at Killarney and now 9lb higher; that was only her second handicap start and rider thinks she'll stay farther than that extended 1m3f trip.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Best effort so far when front-running fourth over 9.5f at Ballinrobe; trip is a concern.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Last-to-first victor over 1m4f at Bellewstown (solid form for 0-60 grade); went up 11lb for decisive nature of that win; beaten fractions when third on hurdling debut since.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Formerly with Private Larry's trainer; promise in maidens, particularly at Down Royal on stable debut;  modest handicap debut over 1m4f on AW and now blinkered.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Couple of okay runs in maidens, but beaten 21l on handicap debut at Limerick two runs back and tailed off in maiden at same venue since; headgear on and champion jockey rides.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Bought for 15,000gns lately; maiden's best run was when third over 11.5f on soft ground at Yarmouth; third of four over 1m6f at same track on last start for Charlie Fellowes.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
OwnerName: Thomas J Quinn & Brian P Whelan
Spotlight: First handicap run over 1m was okay, but well beaten over 10.5f in May; blinkers replace cheekpieces and pedigree suggests she might stay, but plenty to prove.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Half-sister to three winners at up to 1m; never a factor in her maidens over 7f; marked step up in trip for first handicap.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Has been beaten 24l+ in three maidens at up to 10.5f; headgear on for handicap debut and not really bred for this far.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Second runner for yard; not beaten that far in first two handicaps over around 1m1f; markedly up in trip, but related to 1m3f winner and Listed-winning dam won over 1m6f.

RaceName: Guinness Handicap
Spotlight: Went closest to first win when front-running second to Chicago Moon over extended 1m3f at Killarney; same tactics were used last time over 1m4f at Cork when faded late to finish fifth.

RaceName: Bet Central Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Often front-runner; won twice last year, both on ground faster than good, and ran well in a classified event at Chepstow last month on her first start for 246 days; should go well.

RaceName: Bet Central Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 13-race maiden who went close at Nottingham (5f, soft) in June; respectable effort here over 6f two weeks ago and now drops back in trip with an each-way chance.

RaceName: Bet Central Classified Stakes
Spotlight: 27-race maiden who has failed to beat a rival home in each of his last three starts, most recently at Newmarket five days ago; visor returns but he has plenty to prove.

RaceName: Bet Central Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Sole win from 37 starts came on the AW at Lingfield (5f) last April; runner-up at Bath (5.7f, good to firm) in May but she's struggled in four starts since; stablemate of Banana.

RaceName: Bet Central Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Best effort from four starts came when fourth of 12 in a novice at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May; well beaten here over 7f on her handicap debut last month but she could be suited by this drop to 5f.

RaceName: Bet Central Classified Stakes
OwnerName: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells
Spotlight: 3yo filly who ran to a similar level in two 5f AW starts in January; raced too freely at Southwell (7f, AW) last time on her first start for six months but the drop back in trip looks a positive on her turf debut.

RaceName: Bet Central Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Well held on her first three starts and she beat only one rival home in a classified event here over 6f in June; drops in trip with better needed.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Has continued to run well since winning two Southwell novices (6f, Tapeta) in the spring, most recently when beaten half a length into fourth of ten in a handicap at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) last month (third has won since); extra furlong should be within range; high on the list.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Lingfield novice winner (6f, Polytrack) in December but, having been gelded, has finished well held in two Newmarket handicaps (6f/7f) since returning in June; return to Polytrack is a positive, but he still has a bit to prove.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Made a successful return in an uncompetitive Lingfield novice (1m, Polytrack) in February, but not built on it in two handicaps on turf/Tapeta since; bit more needed back down in trip.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: His two runs over 7f on Polytrack last year were much better than one over 6f on turf, the latest when second of 11 in a Chelmsford novice in September (form worked out well); gelded since and worth a second look on handicap debut after 321 days off.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: High-class pedigree; made a promising start when beaten a length into third of six at Newmaket (7f, good to firm) in July last year, but regressed in two subsequent outings including on her reappearance in June; market support on this handicap/AW debut would be worth noting.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
OwnerName: Alfa Site Services Ltd & Graeme Curnow
Spotlight: Made a successful reappearance in a Musselburgh maiden (7f, good) in May and was surrounded by subsequent winners when third of six back there (1m1f, good) last time; shortlisted back down in trip and returned to the AW.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Has been racing over further since making a successful handicap debut/reappearance at Lingfield (7f, Polytrack) in April, narrowly regaining winning form at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) 11 days ago; only 2lb higher and return to this trip shouldn't be an issue; cheekpieces given a go.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
Spotlight: Regressed after being beaten a neck in a 1m novice here in April, but bounced back to form with a narrow success at Bath (5.7f, good) last time; a few winners have come out of that race and he's shortlisted despite a 3lb higher mark.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Winner over 1m6f at Navan in October and ran well at Galway next time; six month layoff since hurdles outing early this year; goes well on soft.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced since back-to-back wins over hurdles in 2023; on second start for this yard, bolted up over this trip at Ballinrobe where cheekpieces went on for the first time and usual tongue-tie was discarded; 13lb rise still leaves him eligible for basement grade.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Had useful maiden form at three for Noel Meade and landed maiden hurdle last summer; hit form for this yard when close third over 1m4f at Limerick, and kept on steadily when beaten 4l over extended 1m3f at Killarney; waited with lately, so wide draw won't matter much.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden was touched off over C&D on last year's card, and some good efforts on soft or heavy ground in the autumn; form not as good this term and was too keen in cheekpieces when beaten 7l by Deluca Chop at Navan last time.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Five Flat wins; good second of 19 over this trip at Leopardstown in May, but has struggled since; goes on any ground.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to place in 12 starts; fair effort on latest handicap start when beaten less than 6l over 10.5f here in May.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: 7yo has hit a rich vein of form this year; no worse than third in six starts and on a hat-trick after hard-fought wins over this trip at Navan and Down Royal; ground-versatile.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner has been second over around 1m4f on turf last twice; just in front of Young Churchill at Limerick last time; softening ground might be a concern, as he's not proven on it.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Synd'/D O'Leary/J McNally
Spotlight: Winner over this trip last year; has mixed Flat racing with hurdling this year; decent fifth, less than 2l off Deluca Chop, at Navan in June and good run over hurdles a week later; not as effective lately; ground-versatile.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Small filly has had some fair runs on turf, but AW third over 1m4f was her first time to be placed; stuck to her task well in first-time cheekpieces that day.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly-raced mare has been off since handicap debut on AW in November, beaten around 6l over 10.5f; tongue-tie.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden has been off since March when beaten 12l over 1m2f at Navan; tongue-tie.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Glimmers of ability, including on latest when beaten 4.5l over 1m4f at Roscommon in May; visor on then, back to cheekpieces here; handles soft ground.

RaceName: Rockshore Cider Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form in seven Flat starts and was 16l behind Deluca Chop at Down Royal on seasonal debut in June; no better since.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Front-runner who won twice at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) and once over hurdles in the spring; up another 4lb on this return to the Flat and may not be allowed his own way this time.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Sole success came at Catterick (1m4f, good) in April; has been placed over hurdles, but has stamina to prove over this far on the Flat.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Six wins over 1m6f-16.5f on the Flat including four on the AW; comfortable winner over hurdles in June and a major player.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Didn't look an easy ride at Yarmouth (1m6f, soft) in June but still managed to win readily; has winning form on Polytrack and is likely to make his presence felt despite a 5lb rise.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Back off the same mark as when making all at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) last September when in the care of Jamie Osborne, but not at his best lately and similar tactics won't be easy in this field.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Three wins at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) this year, the latest when just beating a subsequent winner from 3lb lower last month; ran well in one previous visit here and, although yet to attempt this far on the Flat, would be a player if he stays.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Consistent in handicaps since winning a Southwell novice (1m4f, Tapeta) in April, only finding one too good in her last two starts; stepping up again in trip may suit her and she again shouldn't be far away with cheekpieces given a go.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Formerly a fair hurdler/chaser, but the wheels have come right off; no appeal despite another 4lb drop.
